_why: Every project on this machine that imports claude_console, and how to run
its tests. Consumers install EDITABLE, so they always get the newest code
with no update step -- which means the risk runs the other way: a change
here reaches every consumer instantly, and nothing tells you it broke one
runs it whenever anything under claude_console/ is edited. Adding a project
is one entry here -- no code change, and the hook picks it up immediately.
python is relative to path; verify is argv passed to that interpreter.
